Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards (2502.01456v2) · paper method: PRIME can initialize its PRM from the starting SFT/base policy and filters prompts by their sampled accuracy range during training.

  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The described filtering aims at intermediate difficulty and PRM data balance; exact selected accuracy bounds are not specified by this claim.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards (2502.01456v2) · paper method: PRIME updates an implicit PRM online using policy rollouts and outcome supervision and uses token-level dense rewards for policy training.

cohort8.claim.prime.online-prm

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Outcome labels or verifier rewards are still required; “no process labels” does not mean supervision-free.
  • Section 3.1 describes updating the PRM then calculating rewards, while Algorithm 1 computes process rewards at step 7 before updating the PRM at step 8. Appendix B.2 specifies default single-forward rewards from the old PRM; double-forward recomputes rewards with the updated PRM. The prose and algorithm ordering are retained separately, with reward timing qualified by the stated variant.

Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards (2502.01456v2) · paper method: The instantiated advantage estimator computes implicit-process and outcome returns separately before combining them, using leave-one-out baselines.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards (2502.01456v2) · paper method: The implicit PRM parameterizes reward with the log likelihood ratio of a reward language model to a reference model, yielding token-level process rewards.
